verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਫਨ ਪੈ ਧਰਨਿ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਿਰਧਰ ਕਹੈ ਕੌਨ ਬਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa kai ek fan pai dharan hai so dharaneedhar taeh giradhar kahai kauan baddiaaiee hai ||

en.bdb: God created Sheshnag who is believed to be supporting the Earth on one of his thousand heads, and he is called Dharnidhar, and if his creator is called by the name of Girdhar (lifter of Goverdhan mountain-Krishan) what sort of praise is his?

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਨਾਥ ਤਾਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਜਨਾਥ ਕਹੈ ਕੌਨ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa kai ek baavaro kahaavat hai bisavainaath taeh birajanaath kahai kauan adhikaiee hai ||

en.bdb: The creator who has created a crazy (Shiv Ji) and is called Vishwanath (master of the Universe), if his creator is called Brijnath (master of Braj region-Sri Krishan) then what is so praiseworthy about him?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰ ਓਂਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਨੰਦ ਨੰਦ ਕਹੈ ਕਉਨ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sagal akaar o(n)kaar ke bithaare jin taeh na(n)dh na(n)dh kahai kaun Thakuraiee hai ||

en.bdb: The creator who has created this entire expanse, if that creator is called son of Nand-Krishan Ji, then what is so great about him?

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਅੰਧ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੋਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੬੭੧॥
verses.translit_en: ausatat jaan ni(n)dhaa karat agiaan a(n)dh aaise hee araadhan te mon sukhadhaiee hai ||671||

en.bdb: (So by such type of worship) ignorant and blind of knowledge consider Lord's worship being performed, but instead, they are slandering Him. Remaining silent is far better than this type of worship.  (671)
